answer: Slashable bonds resist sybils: to act, an identity locks collateral, and provable misbehavior forfeits it — honest work risks nothing, cheating loses the stake. A fake adrift on the ocean must still fund its own shale-hard bond, and one caught clone forfeits the whole deposit — the slash is a clear signal. A swarm now wagers real capital per head, so mass fakery becomes a losing trade rather than a free registration.
